user.title: Session cookie for Intradel
user.description: The Intradel login form is protected by a reCAPTCHA that the site verifies server-side, so a username and password cannot be used here. Log in at {intradel_url} in a regular browser, then copy the value of the "Cookie" request header and paste it below.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Intradel
reauth_confirm.description: The stored session cookie is no longer valid. Log in again at {intradel_url} in a regular browser and paste a fresh session cookie.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect, please try again

data.keepalive_interval: Minutes between session keep-alive pings (0 to disable)
data.quota_organic_kg: Organic waste quota (kg per person per year)
data.quota_residual_kg: Residual waste quota (kg per person per year)

empty_cookie.message: The session cookie cannot be empty.

invalid_cookie.message: Intradel rejected this session cookie. Log in again in your browser and capture a fresh one.

set_cookie.name: Set session cookie
set_cookie.description: Replaces the stored Intradel session cookie with one captured from a browser that is already logged in.

cookie.name: Session cookie
cookie.description: The value of the Cookie request header, e.g. PHPSESSID=...
